title: Asthma Exacerbation Prediction and Risk Factor Analysis Based on a Time-Sensitive, Attentive Neural Network: Retrospective Cohort Study.
summary: The JMIR article reports a time-sensitive attentive neural network for asthma-exacerbation prediction in 31,433 adults, with five-fold cross-validation and patient/cohort-level factor analysis. The paper appeared in Journal of Medical Internet Research. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
